lessons: Add tests/test_author.py cases for criterion 3 via main(["triage"]) with FakeLLM: an author reply naming an existing tickets/<stem>/, and one failing validate_ticket; assert the next author request's retry_findings carries those findings.

Add an allowance-exhaustion test: feed invalid author replies until caps.retry runs out; assert no `chupa(<stem>): ticket` commit, one `chupa(decisions): decision-<id>` commit, and resolution {kind: decision, link: decision-<id>}.

Add criterion 4 tests: a bug_report with no has_repro gets a decision-<id> record and only the triage request (zero author requests); a recorded author verdict plus a journaled author_invoked signal gets the record with zero requests.

In tests/test_triage.py, change only the author-verdict expectations. Restore the stale-version block: record an author verdict at 0.9 on a fresh pending message, then assert no new request, a decision-<id> commit, and a body naming both 0.9 and 1.0.

Before finishing, map each acceptance criterion to a named test, and diff test_triage.py against base to confirm no other assertion was deleted. Passing tests alone do not prove the criteria are covered.
